<!--
Every pull request starts with this brief, written for the owner, who does not read code.
Keep it to one screen. No code words. The check "Owner brief" refuses a pull request
whose brief is missing a part or still has a placeholder in it.
-->

## For the owner

**What this is:** <one sentence>

**What changes if you approve:**
- <the file or group of files, named for what it is>: <what it says or does now>, becomes <what it will say or do>

**What does not change:** <what a reader might fear is touched and is not>

**Why:** <the story id and title, or the request this answers>

**How it was checked:** <each check, who or what ran it, and the result>

**Not checked:** <what, and why. Write "Nothing" if nothing>

**After you approve:** <what happens next, and who does it>

**To undo:** <how this is reversed if it turns out wrong>

**Your action:** <Approve | Test first with /kue-sign | None, this merges when the checks pass>

## Details

**Kind:** Acceptance | Build | Sign-off | Change request | Release

<Everything else the kind of pull request calls for: the work order's checks, the test numbers, the safety review, the record of what the owner tested.>
